profile.name: RATCH GROUP PUBLIC COMPANY LIMITED
profile.businessType: The Company is operated as a holding company, RATCH seeks to equity invest in core companies, subsidiaries, and/ or joint ventures, subject to its shareholding proportion. Its investment is mainly focused on fossil fuel power generation projects, renewable projects as well as businesses adjacent to electricity generation and energy both in Thailand and internationally. Its main incomes are in forms of dividend and profit sharing from invested companies.
